exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.reason: Rotational cable chop; no woodchop/chopper entry.
exercises.difficultyReason: Rotational cable core work; aligned with Cable Crunch (intermediate) anti-rotation/bracing demands.

exercises.name: Garhammer Raise
exercises.reason: Hanging/decline leg raise to bench variant named for Garhammer; missing from catalog.
exercises.difficultyReason: Combines hanging leg raise complexity with bench/Garhammer setup; harder than Hanging Leg Raise (intermediate).

exercises.name: Heel Touch
exercises.reason: Supine oblique heel-reach crunch; not covered by heel-to-toe walk or generic crunches.

exercises.name: Landmine Rotation
exercises.reason: Landmine anti-rotation/rotation; no landmine rotation entry.
exercises.difficultyReason: Landmine-loaded rotation; comparable technical load to Landmine Press (intermediate).

exercises.name: Renegade Row
exercises.reason: Plank-position alternating row; no renegade-row entry in catalog.
exercises.difficultyReason: Plank anti-rotation plus alternating row; high stability/coordination vs standard rows (intermediate).

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
exercises.reason: Dynamic side-plank hip lowering; distinct from static side plank.
exercises.difficultyReason: Dynamic lateral core beyond static Side Plank (beginner); added hip control under load.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Crunch
exercises.reason: Crunch on stability ball; not in catalog (distinct from floor crunches).
exercises.difficultyReason: Trunk flexion pattern like Crunches (beginner) with mild instability from ball.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Rollout
exercises.reason: Anti-extension rollout on a stability ball; catalog has ab-wheel rollout only (different implement).
exercises.difficultyReason: Anti-extension rollout; same progression tier as Ab Wheel Rollout (intermediate).

exercises.name: Stomach Vacuum
exercises.reason: Transverse-abdominis vacuum/bracing drill; no catalog entry.

exercises.name: Toe Touch Crunch
exercises.reason: Reach-to-toes crunch pattern; not toes-to-bar or generic crunches.

exercises.name: TRX Knee Tuck
exercises.reason: Suspension knee tuck; distinct from stability-ball knee tuck (TRX anchor).
exercises.difficultyReason: Suspension core tuck; matches Stability Ball Knee Tuck (intermediate) / TRX Plank tier.

exercises.name: TRX Pike
exercises.reason: Suspension pike; not equivalent to floor/ball pike entries alone.
exercises.difficultyReason: Suspension pike; comparable to Hanging Pike / Ball Pike (advanced) shoulder+core demand.

exercises.name: Cable Pullover
exercises.reason: Straight-arm cable pullover; catalog has DB/barbell pullovers but no cable stack pullover.
exercises.difficultyReason: Straight-arm lat sweep; same tier as Dumbbell/Barbell Pullover (intermediate).

exercises.name: Commando Pull-Up

exercises.name: High Row Machine

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Row Machine
exercises.reason: Independent-arm machine row; distinct from chest-supported DB row.

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.reason: Landmine base row variation; not landmine press.

exercises.name: Meadows Row

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row

exercises.name: Seal Row
